messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - eu-central-1 GPU quota exhausted, autoscale failing to provision additional nodes. Paging Maya and Sam.
Maya (oncall): ack, I'm on it. Observing queue spike and 429s on /v1/generate.
Maya (oncall): summary - dedicated pools in eu-central-1 hit vGPU quota, scale-up returning errors from k8s cloudprovider: "quotaExceeded". Traffic is queuing in proxy, latency >5s.
Sam (sre): saw the same. Queue depth up 3.2k, tail latency 12s. Rolling deploys? any cannary recently?
Priya (runtime): no recent model rollout. Fallback caching is on but KV cache miss rate is high for these requests (new prompts).
Raj (infra): Confirming, ASG attempts to create 4 new GPU instances and API returns 403/QuotaExceeded from AWS: 
```
Error: You have requested more vCPU capacity than your current account provides. Please visit ... to request an increase.
```
Raj (infra): Looks like we hit regional quota for p4/p3 family in eu-central-1.
Maya (oncall): tagging customers: Olivia can you surface major customers impacted?
Olivia (cust-succ): Notified top 5 active accounts on eu-central. Two reported degraded experiences (chat lags and timeouts). Putting them on notification list and offering temporary traffic steering.
Sam (sre): Mitigation options: 1) divert traffic to eu-west-1/US-west 2) use smaller instance types (lower GPU capability) + fall back to quantized model 3) burst to spot/other AZs if quota available. Any constraints?
Priya (runtime): Quantized variant is compatible but increases inference latency ~15-25% for some prompts. We can trigger automatic model variant fallback for non-SLA customers.
Raj (infra): I can attempt cross-region scale: start fresh pools in eu-west-1. Need config change in routing policy (smart-routing). How many shards? estimate 8 nodes to absorb current backlog.
Maya (oncall): Do it. Prioritize non-reserved customer traffic to other regions. Keep reserved/dedicated pinned to their region (they paid).
deploy-bot: Starting config change: route-policy=eu-central-failover -> enable eu-west-1.
Raj (infra): config applied, initiating scaleup in eu-west-1 now. Creating ASG with equivalent machine type.
incident-bot: action taken: traffic steering enabled at 1769002000. Expect 5-10m to drain queues as new instances come up.
Sam (sre): Monitoring queue length... it dropped 18% after steering. Still have ~2.6k queued.
Maya (oncall): Parallel action: Raj, open support case with AWS for quota increase and escalation. Put urgency as production outage.
Raj (infra): AWS support case opened (case # 2026-EC-8347). Requesting emergency quota increase for p4 and p3 families in eu-central-1.
Raj (infra): Also trying to create smaller g4dn instances in eu-central-1 to see if they are available under different quota.
Priya (runtime): If g4 available, we can run a runtime path using mixed precision that supports g4. Need a quick config flip. I can prepare a deploy patch and a runbook snippet.
Maya (oncall): Sam, coordinate with Priya to allow non-SLA inference to use quantized + g4 fallback.
Sam (sre): Doing it now. Pushing route rules to label customer tiers.
Olivia (cust-succ): Notifying impacted enterprise customers with ETA: initial mitigation rolling; full recovery dependent on AWS quota increase. Will offer credits and temporary cross-region routing.
Maya (oncall): Observability note: tagging this incident as GPU-QUOTA-EU-CENTRAL. Start incident timeline and capture logs.
Raj (infra): AWS response received: acknowledged, escalated to EMEA capacity team. Estimated time to resolution 2-6 hours. They asked for traffic reduction while they reassign capacity.
Sam (sre): Based on that, continue cross-region steering. We'll keep a small pool in eu-central to serve reserved capacity only.
Priya (runtime): Implemented model fallback rules: priority order -> full model (eu-central dedicated) -> quantized on g4/gpu-other -> cpu fallback (low-priority).
Maya (oncall): Quick checks: CPU fallback is very slow and should be used only for non-interactive batch jobs.
deploy-bot: Applied runtime config at 1769003120: fallback-priority updated.
Maya (oncall): Any error spikes or new regressions?
Sam (sre): Some 500s from node provisioning race but no new customer-facing errors beyond timeouts before steering.
Olivia (cust-succ): Customer A accepted cross-region steering. Customer B requested SLA exception and needs all traffic kept in eu-central. We advised best-effort and that dedicated contracts will be prioritized post-queue drain.
Maya (oncall): Logging action items: 1) Raj follow up w/AWS until quota increased 2) Sam and Priya validate fallback perf for top customers 3) Olivia keep customer comms 4) Runbook update for multi-region steering.
Raj (infra): Also initiating internal request for reserved capacity in eu-central to avoid repeat. Sending procurement note.
Sam (sre): Current metrics: queue down to ~900, tail latency trending to 1.8s for steered traffic. Good.
Maya (oncall): Great. I'll stay on until full recovery and then handoff to Sam for post-incident.
incident-bot: HANDOFF: Maya -> Sam at 1769005400.
Maya (oncall): Handoff notes: AWS case #2026-EC-8347, cross-region steering active, reserved pools pinned, fallback rules applied. Keeping incident channel open.
Sam (sre): Taking over. I'll run through RCA checklist and coordinate postmortem.
Raj (infra): AWS updated: temporary quota increased to allow 6 additional GPUs in eu-central as of 1769005800. Scaling now allowed; beginning phased restore of eu-central capacity.
Priya (runtime): Restoring normal routing for high-priority customers as eu-central nodes finalize join.
Olivia (cust-succ): Customers reported improved UX. No customer escalations in last 30m.
Maya (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. Still P1 until fully restored.
Sam (sre): Creating postmortem draft and will include: why quota threshold wasn't predicted by capacity forecasts, why autoscaler didn't fall back earlier, and how to automate temporary cross-region steering sooner.
Maya (oncall): Action item: add alert that warns at 80% of regional GPU quota with a runbook link.
Raj (infra): Noted. I'll add quota-saturation alert and a synthetic that tries to provision a test GPU to detect soft limits.
Priya (runtime): I'll add a quick test in canary to exercise fallback variants when provisioning fails.
Sam (sre): End notes and retrospective owners assigned. Closing on-call shift.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Timestamp 1769006120.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Follow-up in #postmortems with RCA draft.
Olivia (cust-succ): Will send customer summary and credits proposal to legal/finance for approval.
Raj (infra): Filing procurement ticket for reserved capacity in eu-central-1.
Priya (runtime): Leaving a small checklist in runbook: quota-case template, steering commands, fallback toggles.
Sam (sre): I'll schedule the postmortem meeting tomorrow.
Maya (oncall): off to handover. :raised_hands:
